topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: The rain's been lashing at the city, turning the streets into rivers, but the water can't wash away the secrets people stash in their attics. Got a call from a homeowner, voice steady but eyes likely darting, found some crates up there where the light don’t reach much. Asked what was inside, got a list of usual suspects—old clothes, books, maybe a broken clock. But there's more, I can tell. People always leave behind the things that weigh too heavy to carry. I said I'd need a day, gave him my rate. He agreed, but his tone made it clear this wasn’t just about cleaning house. Gonna need to tread carefully, this attic probably holds more than just dust and forgotten trinkets.
